assay: bulk total RNA-seq (TruSeq Stranded Total RNA, Ribo-Zero Gold), vastus lateralis, Kallisto GRCh38 gene counts (S2.12.6.p1)
sample_inclusion: untrained pre-menopausal females, 12-week resistance training; 27 completed; Fig 7 legend: n = 35 pre-training, 27 post-training (S2.2.p1, FIG7)
primary_estimand: within-participant change in vastus lateralis gene expression after 12 weeks of resistance training (POST vs PRE), DESeq2 ~ ID + timepoint
planned_contrasts: timepoint POST vs PRE (S3.6.p1, FIG7; paper: 214 DEGs, 122 up, 92 down at FDR < 0.05)
gene_filter: text: mean across samples <= 10 RPM removed (63%), 14,979 genes kept (S2.12.6.p1); authors' code: rowMeans(counts) >= 10
paper_method: DESeq2 ~ ID + timepoint (S2.14.p6); results() defaults (alpha 0.1) per authors' GitHub script
paper_results: 214 DEGs (122 up, 92 down); RPS6KC1 up 11% FDR < 0.01; TRIM63, FBXO32, TRAF6, FOXO1, FOXO3 unchanged; AR mRNA FDR = 0.956 (S3.6.p1, S3.4.p2, S3.3)
secondary_analyses_not_reproduced: ChEA3 TF enrichment on DEGs; gene association with total testosterone (no hormone values in GEO)
